Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
We are looking for an Embedded Software Tester to join our Randstad Digital Romania team in Bucharest for a specialized project. Our partner is a major player in railway infrastructure, developing advanced signaling, traffic management, and digital train control systems. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability of safety-critical railway interlocking solutions by designing and executing embedded software test cases for the Distributed Control Architecture (DCA) product.
 Responsibilities 
Specification of Test Cases on Requirements basis (including performance and boundary tests).
Implementation of Test Cases for software-software and software-hardware integration tests.
Ability to test case design, test automation and test execution.
Preparation of test campaigns with functional tests and non-regression tests.
Detailed description of reproduction scenario when finding bugs.
Evaluation of the test output (coverage, traceability, progress).
Test documentation & test environment maintainability.
Project monitoring (ex: monitoring of non-conformities correction, test result reporting).
Prepare the hardware and software configuration for testing activities.
 Requirements 
At least 1 years of experience in a similar role.
Embedded Software Testing skills and basic OOP knowledge.
Linux & Operating Systems Fundamentals.
Knowledge of Version Control Systems (Git, ClearCase, etc.).
Experience with Real-Time or Safety-Critical Systems.
Commitment to the highest levels of quality.
Intercultural communication skills, including the empathy to work in an international team.
Bachelor’s degree (or currently studying) in Computer Science or a similar technical domain.
Strong proficiency in English language (spoken and written).
 Benefits 
Attractive salary package according to your experience and seniority bonus;
The 13th salary depending on company’s performance;
Bonus for internal recommendations;
Meal tickets;
Private health insurance, including dental services and psychological consultations;
Flexible working hours (core-hours system);
Access to over 600 sports centers in the 7Card network;
Online language courses: English and French;
Access to the e-learning platform;
Access to technical training programs / workshops, as well as other technical events (both as a participant and as a speaker);
Development opportunities through involvement in internship & mentoring programs;
Access to soft-skills programs and workshops;
Access to various internal events and team-buildings;
Access to international opportunities for career development with challenging and exciting projects in a dynamic international working environment;
Paid days off offered for involvement in volunteering activities and for bank holidays occasion.
 Kindly note that only suitable candidates will be contacted.
